promoCards.title: Dragon Champion Lazarus
powers: {Lazarus} deals himself 2 irreducible toxic damage. Change to {Lazarus}' dragon character card.

promoCards.title: Dragon Champion Lazarus (dragon form)
powers: {Lazarus} deals himself 2 irreducible toxic damage, then either deals 1 target 3 melee damage or each villain target 2 toxic damage.

cards.title: Lazarus
powers: {Lazarus} deals himself 1 irreducible toxic damage. Draw a card or {Lazarus} deals 1 target 2 melee damage.
incapacitatedAbilities: Reduce the next damage dealt to a hero by 2.
One player may discard 2 cards. If 2 cards are discarded this way, flip {Lazarus}, restore him to 1 HP, and draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Breath of Life
body: Each hero target gains 1 HP. Draw a card.

cards.title: Brutal Sweep
body: {Lazarus} deals 1 target 1 melee damage then may deal 1 other target the same damage then may deal a third target the same damage.

cards.title: Burst of Strength
body: {Lazarus} gains 2 HP and deals 1 target 2 melee damage.

cards.title: Chains of Eternity
body: When one of your other non-character cards would be destroyed, {Lazarus} may deal himself 4 irreducible toxic damage. If he takes damage this way, prevent that destruction.
powers: {Lazarus} deals himself 5 toxic damage. One other hero gains HP equal to the damage dealt this way

cards.title: Defy Death
body: If {Lazarus} has less than 10 HP, he gains 5 HP. Otherwise, he gains 3 HP.

cards.title: Dragoncleaver
body: Increase melee damage dealt by {Lazarus} by 1.
powers: {Lazarus} deals up to 2 targets 1 melee damage each. He may deal another target 3 melee damage. If damage is dealt this way, destroy this card.

cards.title: Push Through Pain
body: The first time each turn {Lazarus} deals himself toxic damage, {Lazarus} gains 1 HP.

cards.title: Quick Recovery
body: {Lazarus} gains 2 HP. Draw until you have 4 or more cards in your hand.

cards.title: Regenerator's Rage
body: {Lazarus} gains 1 HP. Increase damage dealt by {Lazarus} by 1 until the end of your next turn. You may play a card.

cards.title: Siphon Blast
body: {Lazarus} deals each other target 1 infernal damage. When a hero target would be dealt damage this way, you may prevent it. If you do, that hero gains 1 HP and {Lazarus} deals himself 1 irreducible toxic damage. When a non-hero target is dealt damage this way, that target deals itself 1 irreducible toxic damage and {Lazarus} gains 1 HP.

cards.title: Throwing Spikes
body: At the start of your turn, you may destroy this card. When this card is destroyed, {Lazarus} deals each villain target 2 projectile damage.
powers: Increase the next melee damage dealt by {Lazarus} by 1 and change its type to projectile.

cards.title: Undying Champion
body: The first time each turn {Lazarus} would be reduced to 0 or less HP, prevent that damage and set {Lazarus}' HP to 1. Then you may draw a card and play a card and {Lazarus} deals himself 1 irreducible toxic damage.

cards.title: Vengeful Fist
body: {Lazarus} deals 1 target 3 melee damage. If that target dealt damage to {Lazarus} since the start of your last turn, increase this damage by 1, {Lazarus} gains 1 HP, and draw a card.

cards.title: Vital Force
body: At the start of your turn, {Lazarus} gains 1 HP
